description: An armed pre-start fence catches a response the session has never seen before: the fence exists precisely because the response id is not known yet. The fenced response keeps the provider slot until its own terminal, so a Guard cannot open a second inference while this cancellation is in flight -- but holding the slot is not authority, so a final transcript from it is still refused, which is the only place those two questions come apart. Its terminal then releases authority for a response that never spoke.
